name: Polyglyceryl-3 caprate
description: Polyglyceryl-3 caprate (CAS 133654-02-1 ), also known as triglycerol caprate, is a mild, plant-derived emulsifier produced by esterifying polyglycerol with capric acid. It functions as a surfactant and emulsifier across personal care, food, and industrial formulations. This versatile ingredient enables stable oil-in-water systems at low use levels. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetics, it emulsifies light oils and actives into water-based systems, supporting clean-label and naturally derived formulations. Food manufacturers use it to improve fat dispersion and texture in emulsified products where a mild, non-ionic emulsifier is required. In skin care, its humectant character supports moisture retention in lotions and serums without leaving a heavy residue. Coating and adhesive formulators apply it as a wetting and dispersing agent to improve substrate adhesion and pigment distribution. This functionality makes it a valuable component in high-performance industrial applications requiring precise surface tension control. Polyglyceryl-3 caprate is typically supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid or low-viscosity paste. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly available to meet diverse manufacturing needs. Material often meets COSMOS or NATRUE certification requirements for natural and organic formulations.
